description: Computes a number from its inputs with a formula that you write as an ordinary expression. The result goes to the output.

activation.text: Runs when one of the inputs it reads is fresh, or on each pass an enable fires, and the block is enabled. Its enable-out stays on every pass the block is enabled and nothing failed, whether or not the result was recomputed.

group.description: Read by the formula by position; only the inputs it names are read, and every input it names must be wired.
group.label: hidden
